modelVersions.name: Hand F1D v2.0
modelVersions.description:
This version is much better than previous flux version. Chances of extra finger or missng one are reduced. However, you may still experience some weirdness occasionally.

You can try model with or without trigger word(s) and see yourself which works better for you.

In addition, try starting with low lora weight. Start with 0.1 and work you way up till 1.

You'll notice some generated images are much better with low lora weight while others are great with higher weight. It's tricky, but you'll need to adjust the weight till you reach best spot.

F1D v1.5

You can lower lora weight if needed.

You can also use model in other hand focused images (not as good as v2)

modelVersions.name: Hand Pony v1.0
modelVersions.description:
This is Pony v1

It's important to understand, the style has been trained on Pony Diffusion V6 XL

However, I was surprised, it can be used on Cinenauts XL with some good results

No trigger word seems to be required but maybe words like, sharp, detailed, etc. may add more depth.

I don't know how to use Pony, so please, give it a try on your own! (Figure out what's the best outcome you can get using this lora with Pony)
